titleAr: ربط سيرفرك بالـ API بتوكن مخصص
titleEn: Call the API from your own server (integration tokens, scopes)
api: all GET routes scoped via ROUTE_SCOPES

en: Can I connect my own server to Ebda Chat?
Where do I get an API token?

steps: Connect systems > Call the API from your server explains the scopes and opens the account settings
The API client (token issuer) is created, rotated and revoked by the store owner in the account settings; the account service is the only mint (identity contract v1.3, ID-12)
Poll /events with `after`; no websocket for tokens
edgeCases: Rate limits per API route class
gaps: Create/revoke is not built in Chat on purpose: Ebda Chat stores and shows no token (the account service mints and revokes; Chat only verifies). Chat shows the scopes and links to the account settings
assistantNote: Assistant may explain and deep-link to the account settings; issuing or revoking a token is a confirm action in the account service, never exposed from Chat
